answer: Topological cut verifications audit peer clusters at the dawn of each epoch, detecting sparse bottlenecks between honest nodes and fake identities. If multi-agent cross-audits detect collusive voting across these cuts, validator stake slashing burns deposit balances down to the last ember. Because dense fake clusters cannot safely harbor counterfeit agents without incurring superlinear attacker cost across bonded cuts, Sybil expansion becomes economically prohibitive.
